name: Perfora
tagline: Oral care brand selling toothpastes, brushes and mouthwash online
excerpt: Oral care brand Perfora raised ₹80 lakh from three sharks on Shark Tank India Season 2 and has since grown its revenue several times over.
content:
Perfora sells oral care products such as toothpastes, electric toothbrushes, alcohol-free mouthwash and water flossers, mostly online. It was founded in 2021 by Jatan Bawa and Tushar Khurana.

The founders pitched in Shark Tank India Season 2, Episode 34, which aired on 16 February 2023. Inc42 reported that they secured ₹80 lakh at a ₹32 crore valuation, and Social Samosa reported that the money came from three sharks for 2.5%.

Inc42 reported operating revenue of ₹42.2 crore for FY24, up about 180% from ₹15.1 crore, with a consolidated net loss of ₹10.7 crore. In November 2024 Inc42 reported a ₹39.8 crore round led by existing investor RPSG Capital Ventures. The company told Inc42 that the show led to a jump in website traffic and sales in the following months.

Perfora's path shows how a category that looks settled, toothpaste, can still support a new brand that leads with design and ingredients.

shark_tank.pitch_summary: Jatan Bawa and Tushar Khurana pitched a design-led oral care brand and left with ₹80 lakh for 2.5% from three sharks.

lessons: A crowded everyday category can still reward a brand that makes the product feel new.
Revenue grew quickly after the show, but losses grew too; growth funded by marketing needs follow-on capital.
Television exposure works best when the brand already sells online and can capture the traffic.
